command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=yes OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C
cd /tmp
# The env's basis sets come from activation (NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY); without it nwchem falls
# back to the feedstock build path baked into the binary and exits 255. Confirm, don't assume.
test -n "${NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY:-}" && test -f "$NWCHEM_BASIS_LIBRARY/sto-3g"

echo "== NWChem DFT on a real molecule: caffeine, 24 atoms, 6-31G*, B3LYP =="
# Caffeine at its experimental geometry: 24 atoms / 146 basis functions at 6-31G*, which is a
# calculation where parallelism actually does something -- the point of this recipe is the
# openmpi build, and 3 basis functions of water cannot demonstrate it.
cat > caffeine.nw <<'EOF'
echo
start caffeine
memory total 900 mb
geometry units angstrom
  N    1.1700   -1.2200    0.0000
  C    0.0000   -0.4600    0.0000
  N   -1.2200   -1.1300    0.0000
  C   -1.3900   -2.4800    0.0000
  C   -0.1900   -3.2000    0.0000
  C    1.0400   -2.5700    0.0000
  O    2.1400   -3.1300    0.0000
  N   -0.6200    1.3900    0.0000
  C    0.1900    0.9400    0.0000
  O   -0.3200    2.6200    0.0000
  C    2.4700   -0.5800    0.0000
  H    2.5400    0.0400    0.8900
  H    3.2700   -1.3100    0.0000
  H    2.5400    0.0400   -0.8900
  C   -2.4300   -0.3300    0.0000
  H   -2.9900   -0.5200    0.9000
  H   -3.0400   -0.5700   -0.8700
  H   -2.2300    0.7300   -0.0200
  C   -2.7000   -3.1200    0.0000
  H   -3.4700   -2.3600    0.0000
  H   -2.8000   -3.7300    0.8900
  H   -2.8000   -3.7300   -0.8900
  H   -0.2100   -4.2700    0.0000
  H    1.1700    2.2700    0.0000
end
basis
  * library 6-31G*
end
dft
  xc b3lyp
  iterations 60
end
task dft energy
EOF


# PACKING: for a FIXED 16-core box, what is the best way to fill it? The per-job question
# ("how many ranks") is subordinate to this one for anyone with a queue of work -- and a
# single job with 15 idle cores does not contend for memory bandwidth the way 16 concurrent
# jobs do, so the naive "16x the throughput for the same rent" needs measuring.
cpu_usec() { awk '/^usage_usec/{print $2}' /sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0; }
NPROC_BOX=$(nproc --all)
: > pack.txt

pack() {   # $1 = concurrent jobs, $2 = ranks each
  local J=$1 R=$2 i
  rm -rf p; mkdir -p p
  local c0 t0 t1 c1
  c0=$(cpu_usec); t0=$(date +%s)
  for i in $(seq 1 "$J"); do
    mkdir -p "p/$i"; cp caffeine.nw "p/$i/"
    if [ "$R" = 1 ]; then ( cd "p/$i" && nwchem caffeine.nw > out 2>&1 ) &
    # --bind-to none is LOAD-BEARING when packing. Each concurrent mpiexec believes it
    # owns the machine and binds rank k to core k, so 8 concurrent 2-rank jobs pile 16
    # processes onto 2 cores: measured 2342s at exactly 2.00 cores busy, against 148s at
    # 15.83 for the same work as 16 single-rank jobs. The integral core count is the tell.
    else ( cd "p/$i" && mpiexec --bind-to none -n "$R" nwchem caffeine.nw > out 2>&1 ) & fi
  done
  wait
  t1=$(date +%s); c1=$(cpu_usec)
  local wall=$(( t1 - t0 ))
  local ok=$(grep -l "Total DFT energy" p/*/out 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
  local cores=$(awk -v a="$c0" -v b="$c1" -v w="$wall" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", (b-a)/1e6/w}')
  echo "$J $R $wall $ok $cores" >> pack.txt
  echo "  ${J}x${R}rank: ${wall}s for $ok results, ${cores} cores busy"
}

pack 8 2

python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' > smoke-check.txt
RATE = 0.63808           # c8g.4xlarge on-demand, us-west-2
N = 10000                # a modest campaign
rows = [l.split() for l in open("pack.txt")]
box = open("/proc/cpuinfo").read().count("processor\t")
print(f"box_vcpu                   {box}")
print("-- filling ONE c8g.4xlarge: cost of 10,000 caffeine calculations --")
print(f"{'layout':>10} {'wall':>6} {'done':>5} {'cores busy':>11} {'util':>6} {'s/result':>9} {'$/10k':>8}")
best = None
for j, r, w, ok, cores in rows:
    j, r, w, ok, cores = int(j), int(r), float(w), int(ok), float(cores)
    if ok != j:
        print(f"{j}x{r:<8} {w:6.0f} {ok:5d}  INCOMPLETE -- not counted"); continue
    per = w / j                      # wall seconds per result
    cost = per * RATE / 3600 * N
    util = 100 * cores / box
    print(f"{str(j)+'x'+str(r)+'rank':>10} {w:6.0f} {ok:5d} {cores:11.2f} {util:5.1f}% {per:9.1f} {'$'+format(cost,',.0f'):>8}")
    if best is None or cost < best[1]: best = (f"{j}x{r}", cost)
print(f"\nbest layout on this box    {best[0]}  ${best[1]:,.0f} per 10,000")
PYEOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
